description: Simple dashboard for WireGuard VPN written in Python & Vue.js

latest_release.name: WGDashboard v4.3.4
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Had errors on update to 4.3.3 because using double quotes in MySQL expressions triggers errors by @r3bers in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1237
* Update README.md for Docker by @MaxSurtaev in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1292
* fix: use database dialect for configuration backup and restore by @evgenyvolferts in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1370
* Development by @donaldzou in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1326
* chore: remove legacy by @DaanSelen in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1372
* chore: bump all dependencies by @DaanSelen in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1371
* feat: rebuild frontend on every commit by @DaanSelen in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1383
* chore: bring even more dependencies up to date by @DaanSelen in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1396
* chore: merge development into main by @DaanSelen in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1398

## New Contributors
* @MaxSurtaev made their first contribution in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1292
* @evgenyvolferts made their first contribution in https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/pull/1370

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/WGDashboard/WGDashboard/compare/v4.3.3...v4.3.4

WGDashboard

This project is supported by

Monitoring WireGuard is not convenient, in most case, you'll need to login to your server and type wg show. That's why this project is being created, to view and manage all WireGuard configurations in an easy way.

Though all these awesome features are present, we are still striving to make it easy to install and use

This project is not affiliated to the official WireGuard Project
